scope: Targeted property tests verifying higher-order non-linear aggregate projection models (median / quantile sketch cochains) under dynamic streaming deletions and epsilon-BQNF tolerance routing

properties_verified.details: Verified count conservation across dynamic streaming insertions and deletions: sketch.total_count strictly equals the sum of non-zero bucket frequencies and the exact count of surviving elements, with empty buckets cleanly pruned.

Verified interpolation error bound across continuous distributions: the absolute difference between estimated quantile and true median |q_est - q_true| is strictly bounded by the declared bucket width W (10.0).
Verified exact routing: when interpolation error lies within the declared quotient tolerance ball (|err| <= tolerance), routes to Repair; when error breaches tolerance, routes to Recompute.
Verified fail-closed routing under deficient evidence: missing sketch (None) routes to Recompute (MissingQuantileSketch); empty sketch (count=0) routes to Recompute (EmptyQuantileSketch).

Verified full SQLite CDC integration in NormalFormsEvaluator: dynamic insertions, deletions, cache median synchronization, and exact audit records in quantile_repair_log for both Repair and Recompute fallback executions.
